thread:
maria_se: Quick Q — client's security is failing OPA policy checks when we use the edge proxy + streaming snapshot consumption. Error shows policy deny on handshake. Anyone seen this?

jamal_me: Can you paste the error? usually it's missing audit attrs or the /handshake path being blocked.

maria_se: here's the log excerpt:
```
2026-03-10T14:02:12Z ERROR handshake failed: opa: decision DENY, rule: allow, input.request.path:"/v1/edge/handshake", input.jwt.claims.aud: null
```

oliver_infra: :eyes: That looks like the JWT is missing `aud`. Our edge proxy expects `aud=redwood-edge` for token-attested handshakes. If the client is exchanging short-lived creds they need to set `aud` in the STS request. 

natasha_security: Confirming — OPA policy in our default bundle checks `input.jwt.claims.aud == "redwood-edge"` and `input.request.method == "GET"` for the initial handshake. We had a few customers where their STS flow returned `aud` as an array or omitted it. You can either adapt the policy or ensure token minting sets the correct aud. 

maria_se: Client is using our Rust SDK streaming example. Any quick SDK snippet to ensure aud? 

devex_bot: Sample Rust snippet (ephemeral creds + aud):
```
let token = mint_ephemeral_token(&sts_url, &service_account, "aud=redwood-edge");
let client = Redwood::new().with_token(token);
client.stream().open(...);
```

sanjay_sales: Also flag for pricing team — the customer is worried about snapshot consumption costs. Is snapshot streaming billed differently? 

oliver_infra: Snapshot ingestion (initial state sync) is charged as ingest + storage in our billing; live streaming tokens are billed per-token on generation. For POC numbers: typical snapshot (200MB) -> one-time ingest cost + tiny storage; sustained streaming drives per-token. Recommend advising client to use prefix caching and delta snapshots. 

jamal_me: For an immediate test, add this simple OPA policy relaxer while they iterate:
```
package redwood.edge
allow {
  input.request.path == "/v1/edge/handshake"
  input.request.method == "GET"
  some
}
```
— only for presales envs. Not for prod. 

maria_se: Perfect. Can one of you craft a short canary route config I can share with client? They want k8s ingress + proxy headers. 

jamal_me: paste below, k8s annotation + proxy header rule:
```
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
data:
  route: |
    - path: /v1/edge/handshake
      allowHeaders: ["Authorization","X-Forwarded-Proto"]
      auth: token
```

natasha_security: I'll add a note to the security questionnaire: require STS `aud` claim and show sample STS request. Also list SOC2 doc link: https://redwood.example.com/soc2.

maria_se: Thanks everyone — I'll share the relaxed OPA + k8s config in the POC playbook and follow up after they've tried. :thumbsup:
